$comment: Vinara annual indicators: what each series is, where it comes from and how it is read. Sources and licences: docs/vinara-sources.md; rules: docs/vinara-method.md. `definition` is the text the site shows. `imf_fill` names the IMF WEO series that may fill the year before the WEO edition where the World Bank has no figure (labelled an IMF estimate). `max_years` caps how many of the latest years are kept (SIPRI fair use).

indicators.name: Population
indicators.definition: Total population: all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship, mid-year estimate.

indicators.name: Population growth
indicators.definition: Annual population growth, per cent.

indicators.name: Land area
indicators.definition: Land area in square kilometres, excluding inland water bodies, national claims to the continental shelf and exclusive economic zones.

indicators.name: Surface area
indicators.definition: Surface area in square kilometres: land area plus inland water bodies.

indicators.name: GDP
indicators.definition: Gross domestic product in current US dollars, converted at official exchange rates.

indicators.name: GDP at purchasing power parity
indicators.definition: Gross domestic product converted to international dollars at purchasing power parity rates, so that a dollar buys the same amount of goods and services in every country.

indicators.name: GDP per capita (PPP)
indicators.definition: GDP at purchasing power parity divided by mid-year population, in current international dollars.

indicators.name: Real GDP growth
indicators.definition: Annual growth of GDP at constant prices (after inflation), per cent.

indicators.name: Inflation
indicators.definition: Annual change in consumer prices, per cent. A negative figure is deflation.

indicators.name: GNI
indicators.definition: Gross national income in current US dollars: GDP plus net income received from abroad.

indicators.name: Government debt
indicators.definition: General government gross debt as a share of GDP, per cent.

indicators.name: Military spending
indicators.definition: Military expenditure in current US dollars, as estimated by SIPRI.

indicators.name: Military spending (% of GDP)
indicators.definition: Military expenditure as a share of GDP, per cent, as estimated by SIPRI.

indicators.name: Human Development Index
indicators.definition: UNDP's Human Development Index (0 to 1): a summary of life expectancy, education and income per person.

indicators.name: External debt
indicators.definition: Total external debt stocks in current US dollars: debt owed to non-residents, public and private, including IMF credit.

indicators.name: Public external debt
indicators.definition: Public and publicly guaranteed external debt in current US dollars: owed by the government or guaranteed by it.

indicators.name: Owed to multilateral lenders
indicators.definition: Public external debt owed to multilateral institutions (such as the World Bank and the African Development Bank), current US dollars.

indicators.name: Owed to governments
indicators.definition: Public external debt owed to other governments and their agencies (bilateral), current US dollars.

indicators.name: Owed to bondholders
indicators.definition: Public external debt owed to holders of bonds, current US dollars.

indicators.name: Owed to commercial banks
indicators.definition: Public external debt owed to commercial banks, current US dollars.

indicators.name: Owed to other private lenders
indicators.definition: Public external debt owed to other private creditors (such as suppliers), current US dollars.
